# Moraki: full text of Features and FAQ

> The English text of https://moraki.app/features/ and https://moraki.app/faq/, as it appears on the pages.

Source: https://moraki.app/features/

# Everything Moraki does

Moraki is a shared notebook for your newborn, built to be quick, calm and private. Here’s what’s inside.

## The big four, two taps away

Tap a tile and a short sheet slides up. Pick what happened with big buttons, and Moraki fills in the time.

- **Feed**: Breast, bottle or both. Side, minutes, millilitres, formula or breast milk.
- **Sleep**: Start a timer when the baby falls asleep, or add a nap afterwards.
- **Diaper**: Wet, dirty or both, with the time.
- **Pump**: Amount per side, and whether it went to the fridge, the freezer or a bottle.

## And the rest of your baby’s day

- **Weight**: Write it down after a check-up or a home weigh-in.
- **Temperature**: Keep each reading with the time you took it.
- **Medication**: Name, amount and time, so nobody gives a second dose by mistake.
- **Health notes**: A rash, a cough, a question. Write it while you remember.
- **Appointments**: Date, place and the questions you want to ask.
- **Milk stock**: See how much milk you have in the fridge and the freezer.

See what you might log at each stage of the first year

## Every entry, in one place

History shows every entry, newest first, with who logged it. Filter by feeds, diapers, sleep or health.

- **History**: Scroll back through any day. Tap an entry to fix it.
- **Trends**: Totals by day and by week. Moraki adds things up. It doesn’t judge them.
- **Undo**: Logged the wrong thing? Tap Undo right away.

## One notebook for the whole household

- **Invite with a code**: Send a short code to a partner, grandparent or nanny.
- **Caregivers and viewers**: Caregivers log and edit. Viewers see everything but can’t log.
- **Live on every phone**: An entry shows up on every phone in the household within seconds.
- **See who logged it**: Every entry shows who added it, so you never have to ask.

Read the questions about sharing in the FAQ

## Built for the night shift

Moraki is designed for one hand, half asleep, in the dark.

- **Night mode**: Warm, dim colours from 21:00 to 06:00, or whenever you choose.
- **Big buttons**: Large numbers and buttons you can hit without looking twice.
- **Works offline**: No signal in the nursery? Moraki saves first and syncs later.

## Ready when someone asks

- **Call script**: One screen with what a doctor or nurse line usually asks, taken from what you logged.
- **PDF report**: The last days on clean pages, to print or send.

Moraki is a notebook, not medical advice. If you’re worried about your baby, contact your doctor.

## Your baby’s data stays yours

- **Stored in the EU**: Your data lives on servers in the European Union.
- **No ads**: Moraki shows no ads. Not now, not later.
- **No data sold**: We don’t sell your data or hand it to anyone.
- **No analytics**: No trackers and no analytics, in the app or on this site.
- **No account needed**: Start logging right away. Sign in only when you want to share.
- **Export or delete**: Download or delete everything from Settings, whenever you like.

Read the privacy policy

## English and Greek

Use Moraki in English or Greek. Each person in the household can pick their own.

## Start your notebook tonight

Free on iPhone. Invite the others whenever you’re ready.

## Moraki at a glance

- **What it is**: A free newborn tracker: one shared baby log for feeds, diapers, sleep and pumping.
- **Who it’s for**: Parents and everyone who looks after a newborn, like a partner, a grandparent or a nanny.
- **Price**: Free
- **Platform**: iPhone. Android is planned.
- **Languages**: English and Greek
- **Where data is stored**: In the European Union
- **Ads**: None
- **Account needed**: No. You sign in only to share with your household.
- **Made by**: C.E. CODE DESIGNS LTD, Cyprus

# Questions parents ask us

Short answers to the questions we hear most about Moraki. Can’t find yours? Our support page has a way to reach us.

Last updated: [date]

## Getting started

### Is Moraki free?

Yes. Moraki is free to download and free to use. There are no ads.

### Do I need an account?

No. You can start logging right away. You only sign in when you want to share the notebook with someone else.

### Is there an Android version?

Not yet. Moraki is on iPhone first. Android comes next.

### Which languages does it speak?

English and Greek. Each person in your household can choose their own.

## Sharing with your household

### How do I invite someone?

Open Settings, tap Invite someone, choose Caregiver or Viewer, and send them the code.

### What’s the difference between a caregiver and a viewer?

Caregivers can log and edit. Viewers can see everything but can’t log.

### How do I join a household?

Install Moraki, open Settings and tap Join with a code. Type in the code you got.

### Can I take an invite back?

Yes. Each code expires, and you can revoke it from Settings at any time.

## Privacy and your data

### Where is my data stored?

On servers in the European Union.

### Who can see my baby’s data?

Only the people you invite into your household.

### Do you sell data or show ads?

No. We don’t sell your data, we don’t share it for ads, and Moraki shows no ads.

### Can I delete everything?

Yes. Open Settings and go to Your data. You can download everything or delete it all.

## Everyday use

### Does it work without signal?

Yes. Moraki saves each entry on your phone first and syncs when you’re back online.

### I logged something wrong. How do I fix it?

Tap Undo right after you log it. Later, open History, tap the entry and edit it.

### How does night mode work?

Pick Auto, On or Off in Settings. Auto switches to warm, dim colours from 21:00 to 06:00.

### Can I share a report with my doctor?

Yes. Make a PDF of the last days and print it or send it. The call script puts the basics on one screen for a phone call.

## Health questions

### Will Moraki tell me if something is wrong?

No. Moraki writes things down and adds them up. It doesn’t judge them or give medical advice. If you’re worried about your baby, contact your doctor.

### Is Moraki a medical device?

No. It’s a notebook to help you remember and share what happened.

Read the privacy policy

Go to Support

Free on iPhone. Invite the others whenever you’re ready.
